reasoning: On the season so far the Trail Blazers are the stronger team; with home court the Trail Blazers start about 13 points better, in a game of about 228 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Trail Blazers.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Trail Blazers win 87 times in 100, by about 14; most games like this end between 203 and 251 total points.
